scope: Tool output sanitization, secret leakage prevention, untrusted resource links and output-to-model boundary.
implementation_evidence: src/runtime/output_dlp_boundary.js centralizes JSON-compatible output sanitation, high-confidence secret redaction, bounded complexity checks, and cached JSON Schema 2020-12 validation through pinned ajv@8.20.0 without remote schema loading

src/runtime/optional_tool_call_handler.js evaluates every optional-tool payload against its descriptor outputSchema before model-visible serialization, returns a bounded fail-closed tool error on rejection, and audits only policy codes, validation locations, and redaction counts
src/runtime/core_tool_call_handlers.js applies the same output boundary to core search/fetch using the active core descriptor outputSchema

src/runtime/tool_result.js serializes only sanitized payloads into both content JSON and structuredContent, labels the result and content blocks as untrusted_tool_output, allows only validated mcp-artifact://process resource links, redacts embedded text resources, and rejects opaque embedded blobs
src/runtime/mcp_tasks_extension.js validates completed process results against RUN_PROCESS_OUTPUT_SCHEMA and re-applies trust/resource-link filtering after process artifact links are attached

_tests/smoke_output_schema_guard.js and _tests/smoke_process_artifact_task_links.js provide RED-to-GREEN coverage for schema mismatch, nontrivial JSON Schema pattern enforcement, secret redaction, bounded secret-free audit metadata, resource-link filtering, embedded-resource handling, core fetch, Tasks output validation, and output trust metadata
all 98 active outputSchema descriptors compile under the same Ajv 2020-12 validator and no active output schema uses a credential-key property that would collide with the structural redaction key set

the first full DLP suite exposed ten impossible empty closed-object outputSchema placeholders on developer/code-mutation tools; those schemas were repaired to the actual bounded top-level result contracts, and smoke_output_schema_guard now rejects any recurrence across the active 98-tool surface

the first live DLP load exposed optional undefined object properties that JSON serialization historically omitted; the sanitizer now preserves JSON object semantics by omitting only undefined properties while still rejecting functions, symbols, BigInt, cycles, and other non-JSON values

the second live DLP load exposed an over-broad JWT heuristic that matched dotted code identifiers; JWT redaction is now restricted to eyJ-prefixed Base64URL token shapes, with RED-to-GREEN coverage proving dotted identifiers remain intact while JWTs remain redacted

sessionless_ready_review.notes: Root spec reviewed for sessionless-ready workflow posture; stable connector route remains unchanged and sessionless activation/migration remain separate explicit operator stages. The hidden /mcp/sessionless route is a historical transition route, not the final target architecture, and it is now retired from active repo runtime and confirmed absent on live OAuth21 3008 after the controlled restart.
